standing: Born as the third step of the code spine (base -> base pair -> tester), the first real device — the system's notary that runs a proof as a subprocess and produces an eight-field VALIDATION whose verdict comes from the subject's exit code, not granted.

Same day grew its other half — the kernel-owned network's MEASURED seal (isolation.py) — completing the 'tester + kernel-owned network' spine step's no-route half; proven green with no install, the hollow-tester and hollow-seal killers verified by falsification.

Open edge (a) closed — VALIDATIONS are now PERSISTED to beside-code git-JSON (validation_store.py: a validations/<stem>.json beside the proofs each seals, Law 5), NOT db_domain; run_proof still writes nothing and the append-only store refuses a drifted record.

PROVED — THE QUORUM SIGNATURE GATE HAS AN ADDRESS. A node proved by human judgment can now actually be sealed. node_classes/concept-piece.json specified this gate on 2026-07-15 and ZERO concept-piece VALIDATIONs existed in the ten days since — not because a reviewer was slow, but because validations_path_for derived a seal's address from a PROOF FILE path and a concept-piece has no proof file, so the single write-door could not physically accept the record. The gate was never awaiting a signature; it was awaiting an ADDRESS, and CC repeatedly reported the former, which is what kept it stuck. Closed with validations_path_for_artifact (the seal lands beside the artifact, derived not chosen, Law 5) and cairn/devices/tester/quorum.py. Same ratified eight fields, same persist_validation, no rival door (Law 6) — only the addressing was ever missing. Physics: a notary who also reviewed is REFUSED (verdict and seal are different hands; a self-seal is the hollow build, Law 8), a signature with no restated-back understanding is REFUSED (a rubber stamp proves someone clicked, not that anyone read), a quorum means DISTINCT hands, and a rejection is a recorded RED that kicks back (CP2), not an exception. Proven 9/9; full suite 32/32 green, run twice.

standing: PROVED — THE NOTARY NARRATES ITS ACTS. Disposition of troubles/silent-devices-2026-07-27.json: one breadcrumb per run_proof, red and green alike (a red is the notary working, not an anomaly of the notary); pointer=the proof, values={verdict, seal} — the eight-field VALIDATION stays with the caller and the store. Live-fired immediately: the very sealing run of this pass left four run_proof breadcrumbs. 7/7 green, netns-sealed, clean under the gate.

PROVED — THE VALIDATION TRAIL'S DOOR IS NOW THE ONLY PATH (ticket validation-store-door-is-the-only-path, P1, drained from the live trouble). The trail was a record of truth declared APPEND-ONLY by its door and stored as a plain 0644 JSON file: a hand-write destroyed a proof's whole seal history silently and permanently, and looked exactly like a fresh seal (Law 7's worst direction). Closed in three layers that answer three different failure modes — the MODE BIT (0444) stops the accident at the open(); the CHAIN (a door-minted trail_link per record, sha256 over the trail beneath it plus the record itself) makes the deliberate loud, and standing() refuses a broken trail rather than reading a verdict out of it, so harbor_master clears nothing on it; the CORPUS SCAN refuses a second writer at BUILD time rather than at runtime. THE PROOF KILLED THE FIRST DESIGN: a tolerated unlinked prefix ("prehistory") is indistinguishable from a total overwrite, which is the exact destroy-the-history shape the trouble named — a tolerance is a forger's costume whenever the forger can produce the thing tolerated. So the 73 legacy trails were ADOPTED instead: 220 entries linked, all verify, idempotent, and adoption REFUSES to re-link a tampered trail. quorum.record_verdict now returns what LANDED, not what it built (the assembled dict was a second, unlinked copy — the rival-source-of-truth defect MethodRegistry already was). NAMED, NOT GLOSSED: the bytes stay writable to the same uid, nothing here un-destroys a trail, and git carries only the exec bit so a fresh clone lands 0644 until the door next appends — the chain is the half that survives a clone. 9/9 teeth (6 new), quorum 9/9, corpus 86 · 85 green · 1 red over four consecutive runs.
